purpose: Machine-readable policy for auditing false atomic coverage. Traceable or green parent/gate evidence must not be mistaken for proof of every atomic dimension derived from that parent.

evidence_origin_classes.parent-inherited: N3 split target whose validation block is inherited unchanged from its aggregate parent. The evidence identifies the parent mechanism but does not independently prove the child dimension.
evidence_origin_classes.atomic-parent: N3 rule retained as atomic; its validation belongs to the same rule identity, but proof still requires the full proof policy.
evidence_origin_classes.rule-local-promotion: N4 promoted rule with validation declared in its own coverage-rule specification; rule-local declaration still does not by itself imply PROVEN.
evidence_origin_classes.rule-local-override: N3 split target whose normative value and provenance remain inherited but whose validation mechanism is explicitly overridden for that atomic dimension. The override does not by itself imply PROVEN.

exit_criterion: Every full-contract rule has an evidence-origin classification and proof state; no rule is PROVEN from parent-inherited, rule-local-override, or merely registered/green evidence.
